message:
fix(seo): restore item-page stylesheet + add solid background and sticker fills

- FIX: the shared item-page stylesheet was being dropped (empty <style> block),
  so all 660 prerendered pages rendered unstyled. Caused by a PowerShell \$
  interpolation eating the template placeholder.
- BgMode now includes 'solid'; added missing .bgmode-hex / -aurora / -carbon
  patterns with light-theme variants, and surfaced a real background picker in
  the settings modal (live swatches, 8 presets) instead of no UI at all
- settings modal gained the missing week-badges toggle
- every sticker now carries a consistent hatched fill tinted by its glowColor:
  always faintly visible on catalog cards, and as the icon frame on item pages
- prerendered pages support all 8 background presets
author: BSS Index Developer
